title: Lamb Bluebeard
description:
This horror retelling of Bluebeard is part of a Hypno Collective Collaboration.

To be completely honest, I wasn’t sure if I was going to release this file.

It’s frightening.

REALLY Fucking frightening.

This file contains jump scares, creepy nursery rhymes, screaming, threats of death, threats of bodily harm, fear play, obsession, manipulation, and a slowly building sense that something is very, very wrong.

I genuinely thought it might be too scary for most people.

So if you’re going to listen, please understand that this is a horror/fear play file and may not be suited to most people.

You’ve been warned. As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency
author: Lambellina
